experiment: Experiment 8: Automated Grammar Error Correction & Text Rewriting

details.name: 1. Dataset Loading & Preprocessing
details.expected: >= 10 sentence pairs, cleaned text without HTML/entities
details.actual: 20 sentence pairs, cleaned='Although it was raining heavy , but...'

details.name: 2. 60/10/30 Train/Val/Test Split
details.expected: Deterministic 60/10/30 corpus partitions

details.name: 3. Prompt Template Manager & Loading
details.expected: minimal, standard, rewrite, academic, best templates available

details.name: 4. Minimal / Zero-Shot Prompt Generation
details.expected: Minimal correction directive embedding input sentence

details.name: 5. Few-Shot In-Context Prompt Generation
details.expected: In-context demonstration example and target sentence

details.name: 6. Constrained Prompt Generation (v2)
details.expected: Explicit length & technical tone constraints embedded

details.name: 7. Academic Polish / Best Prompt Generation
details.expected: Structured headers and domain polish directives
details.actual: Length: 328 chars, structured headers present: True

details.name: 8. Seq2Seq / FLAN-T5 Model Loading
details.expected: GrammarCorrector initialized and ready
details.actual: Device: cpu, Neural model loaded: True, ready: True

details.name: 9. Grammar Correction Autoregressive Generation
details.expected: Valid corrected sentence fixing grammatical errors
details.actual: Corrected (10 words in 0.00s): 'He went to the laboratory yesterday to do the experiment.'

details.name: 10. Autoregressive Beam Search Decoding
details.expected: Beam search execution with num_beams=4

details.name: 11. Rule-Based Heuristic Baseline
details.expected: Rule-based pattern transformation execution
details.actual: Baseline output: 'He went to the laboratory yesterday to do the experiment.'

details.name: 12. Exact Match Accuracy Scoring
details.expected: Exact match boolean scoring (True for identical, False for different)

details.name: 13. Levenshtein Edit Distance Calculation
details.expected: Self distance = 0; kitten->sitting = 3 edits

details.name: 14. Token-Level Precision, Recall, and F1
details.expected: F1 = 1.000 on exact match; valid F1 on candidate

details.name: 15. GLEU Score Metric Computation
details.expected: GLEU = 1.000 for exact match; valid score for candidate

details.name: 17. Word-Count & Text Statistics Validation
details.expected: Words: 10, Chars: 59

details.name: 18. Over/Under-Correction Diagnostic Heuristics
details.expected: Under-correction=True when output unchanged from error input

details.name: 19. Preservation & Length Compliance Verification
details.expected: Length ratio within bounds (tolerance +-35%)

details.name: 20. Unified Quality & Diagnostic Assessment
details.expected: Complete evaluation bundle with Exact Match, Levenshtein, F1, GLEU

details.name: 21. Local Model Prompt Inference Pipeline
details.expected: Prompt-engineered local correction execution

details.name: 22. FastAPI Backend Health Check
details.expected: HTTP 200, status='healthy'

details.name: 23. File-Upload API Endpoint (/api/files/upload)
details.expected: HTTP 200, status='success'

details.name: 24. Document Text Extraction & Token Estimation
details.expected: Accurate text extraction, word count, estimated tokens

details.name: 25. Chat API Endpoint (/api/chat)
details.expected: HTTP 200, valid assistant response message

details.name: 26. Live Grammar Correction Quality Response
details.expected: Context-augmented grammatical correction returned in chat response
details.actual: Generated: 'Please proofread and correct the grammatical errors in this attac...'

details.name: 27. Response Latency & Token Telemetry
details.expected: Telemetry fields duration_seconds, total_tokens, mode

details.name: 28. Frontend / Backend Web Integration
details.expected: HTTP 200, serves Local LLM Studio HTML UI with interactive proofreader
